The quotation is specifically about capping ground rent (a property income stream) to reduce the cost of enfranchisement (leaseholders buying out their leasehold to gain freehold). The core mechanism is a legislative cap on ground rent affecting leasehold property rights and the pricing of enfranchisement — this is fundamentally about real estate markets and leasehold/freehold property arrangements.

Primary: **R3** (Real Estate Markets) — the cap on ground rent directly affects leasehold property costs and enfranchisement pricing.

Secondary: **K1** (Basic Areas of Law / Property Law) — the instrument is a legislative provision in a draft Bill altering property rights (leasehold reform), which has substantive legal-economic content beyond just real estate markets.
